title: Sea Dweller
meta_description: Sea Dweller pairs a rooftop hot tub, grill \& Gulf views with bikes, pool access \& a short walk to the sand.
description_expanded:
The Gulf shows itself from the top of the house. Sea Dweller's rooftop is where everyone ends up: a private hot tub, a gas grill, and a west-facing view that makes sunset feel like it was scheduled. The home sits in Twin Palms, a small community just off 30Avenue in Inlet Beach, and it was built for families and friend groups who want a polished house and no real reason to touch the car all week.

Four bedrooms sleep eleven, including a king ensuite and a bunk room the kids will claim within about four minutes. A main-floor bedroom keeps things easy for grandparents or anyone who'd rather skip the stairs. Smart TVs throughout, a fully stocked kitchen, and a coffee setup with both pods and drip mean nobody has to negotiate their morning. Balconies on every floor pull the breeze through the house.

Outside is where Sea Dweller leans into the 30A rhythm. Two bikes come with the week, which is the right way to do dinner, a loop through Rosemary Beach's cobblestone streets about a mile out, or the ride west to Alys Beach for ice cream and unapologetic people-watching. Guests also have access to the community pool, an easy cool-down between beach trips. The Donut Hole sits roughly two minutes away on foot, and 30Avenue's restaurants, boutiques, and yoga studio are close enough to count as the front yard. Camp Helen State Park is under a mile east if anyone wants a quiet walk and a coastal dune lake.

When it's beach time, Inlet Beach is the move: wide, open sand with parking, restrooms, showers, and ramp access with no stairs, which matters more than people expect when you're hauling chairs and a cooler. The public access points are about a seven-minute walk south, down Pinewood Lane to Orange Street and across 98. The hardest call of the day is usually whether to stay on the rooftop or chase the light down the shoreline.

BEACH ACCESS: Inlet Beach is one of 30A's best beaches, with space to spread out plus convenient amenities like parking, bathrooms, and showers. It also offers easy ramp access with no stairs to climb. Multiple access points are about two blocks from the home, or you can drive down Pinewood Lane, turn onto Orange Street, cross over 98, and head straight for the sand.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 11
• Bedroom 1 - 1 Queen, hallway bath
• Bedroom 2 -- 1 Queen, ensuite
• Bunk Room -- 1 Twin/Full \& 1 Twin/Twin, shared bath
• Bedroom 4 -- 1 King, ensuite

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Private Rooftop Spa and Lounge area with Gulf Views as well as a gas grill
• 2 Bikes
• Bedroom on Main
• Balcony on every floor
• Smart TVs
• Coffee Maker -- pods and drip
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.
- Pack 'n play is available upon request

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2-3 parking spaces.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
